item.description: Ruston Police have arrested a second person in connection with a shooting that hospitalized a local man earlier this month. item.title: RPD’s Reed named Officer of the Year by Ruston Kiwanis
item.description: Ruston Police Officer Matthew Reed has been named Outstanding Law Enforcement Officer of the Year by the Ruston Kiwanis Club.
